game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the chapel bell using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The chapel bell reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the chapel bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
